WITH f AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS all_net, sum(case when not f.staff_purchase_flag then f.net_amount else 0 end) AS nonstaff_net
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_gross, sum(returns_net) AS rpt_ret, sum(net_sales) AS rpt_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT f.store_id, all_net, nonstaff_net, rpt_gross, rpt_ret, rpt_net FROM f LEFT JOIN r USING(store_id) WHERE f.store_id IN (101,102,115,131,900,999) ORDER BY 1

SELECT f.sale_date, sum(f.net_amount) AS fact_net, max(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_gross, sum(f.net_amount)-max(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS diff
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.business_date=f.sale_date AND r.store_id=900
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26' GROUP BY 1 HAVING abs(sum(f.net_amount)-max(r.net_sales_before_returns))>0.01 ORDER BY 1

SELECT p.category, s.store_id>=900 AS nonstore, s.store_id=999 AS training, count(*) n, count(distinct r.return_line_id) ids, count(distinct r.sales_line_id) sl, sum(r.refund_net) AS refund_net, sum(r.standard_cost_returned) AS cost_ret, sum(case when r.refund_net<0 or r.quantity_returned<=0 then 1 else 0 end) AS odd,
 min(r.return_date) d0, max(r.return_date) d1
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26' AND p.category IN ('Garden','Electrical','ZZ Test')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH movements AS (
  SELECT p.category, p.subcategory, f.net_amount AS net, f.standard_cost AS cst
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26' AND s.store_id <> 999
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.category, p.subcategory, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26' AND s.store_id <> 999
)
SELECT category, round(sum(net),2) AS net_sales, round(sum(net)-sum(cst),2) AS gm, round(100*(sum(net)-sum(cst))/sum(net),2) AS gm_pct,
 round(sum(case when subcategory='Outdoor Lighting' then net else 0 end),2) AS ol_net, round(sum(case when subcategory='Outdoor Lighting' then net-cst else 0 end),2) AS ol_gm
FROM movements WHERE category IN ('Garden','Electrical') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH movements AS (
  SELECT p.category, f.net_amount AS net, f.standard_cost AS cst
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26' AND s.store_id <> 999
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.category, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26' AND s.store_id <> 999
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS fiscal_period, category,
       round(sum(net), 2) AS net_sales,
       round(100 * (sum(net) - sum(cst)) / sum(net), 2) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM movements WHERE category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
